detail.longDescription: Minimum Reproducible Example: import polars as pl df: pl.DataFrame | None = pl.DataFrame({"x": [1]}) if df is None: raise RuntimeError df.with_columns(y=pl.col("x") + 1) Warning: Member None of Any | None does not have attribute with_columns Proof: PyCharm 2026.2.3 Build #PY-262.10968.92, built on September 18, 2026 Windows 11 I already tried: Restart my computer Invalidate Cache and restart PyCharm Run the code Reinstall PyCharm Use df = cast(pl.DataFrame, df) This does not work, PyCharm now gives me another warning "Expected a type"; proof: Windows Updates The last line doesn't do anything, replacing it with df = df.with_columns(y=pl.col("x") + 1) does not solve the problem
